title: Speech to text
summary: OS speech recognizer with a live transcript. Many languages including Czech and German.
limits: Listens until the user pauses (one utterance); call again for the next.
May need network on some Android devices.
Ask for permission with ensurePermission() first, on a user tap.
example:
const speech = useConnector('speech')
const text = await speech.listen({ language: 'en-US' }, setLiveText)
